status: Retrospective analysis plan written after inspecting existing outcomes; not preregistered
purpose: Assess practical prediction decisions against observation-time resources for the MCS article
decision: sufficient when both outer diameters meet original limits; insufficient when either physical inner diameter exceeds its limit; unresolved otherwise
reporting: Report each of four groups and every calibration failure; paired windows are not independent observations; valid-calibration conditioning is for offline evaluation only
limits: Response duration sums are a resource proxy, not measured apparatus cost or CPU time. This is not a prospective adaptive acquisition policy or a validation of a new algorithm.
